branches.suggestion: Hello again! Did you watch the match on Saturday?
branches.suggestionFa: دوباره سلام! شنبه مسابقه را دیدی؟

r2.speaker: learner
r2.text: Yes, I did. What a game!

branches.suggestion: We lost, two-one. I went with Ryan. We didn't score until the ninetieth minute!
branches.suggestionFa: باختیم، دو-یک. با رایان رفتم. تا دقیقهٔ نود گل نزدیم!

r3.speaker: learner
r3.text: That's bad luck. Did Ryan enjoy it?

branches.suggestion: Yeah, we got the train to the ground. It was freezing! Ryan didn't bring a coat, of course.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، با قطار رفتیم ورزشگاه. یخ‌بندون بود! رایان طبق معمول کت نیاورد.

branches.suggestion: He borrowed my scarf. Then he spilt his beef tea all over it!
branches.suggestionFa: شال‌گردن منو قرض گرفت. بعد چای گوشتش را ریخت روش!

branches.suggestion: Leslie washed it twice. It still smells a bit beefy! Did you do anything nice at the weekend?
branches.suggestionFa: لزلی دوبار شستش. هنوز یه کم بوی گوشت میده! تو آخر هفته کار جالبی کردی؟

r6.speaker: learner
r6.text: I didn't do much. I stayed at home and rested.

translations.fa: کار زیادی نکردم. خونه موندم و استراحت کردم.

branches.suggestion: Good for you. Right, here's your stop. Next Saturday, come to the match with us!
branches.suggestionFa: آفرین. خب، اینم ایستگاهت. شنبهٔ بعد با ما بیا مسابقه!
